prompts.cross: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished wide landscape Discord commendation banner, 3:1 aspect ratio. HUSS regiment heraldic award artwork. Subject: a monumental golden winged cross medal, symmetrical swept hussar feather wings, blackened steel center, crimson enamel insets, a small laurel. Antique gold relief craftsmanship on charcoal black leather with a deep crimson ribbon, restrained thin gold border. Center the complete emblem with generous dark space either side, legible at thumbnail size, dramatic warm light, premium detailed metalwork, no visual clutter. Strict palette: crimson red, antique gold, warm ivory and charcoal only; absolutely no blue, cyan, teal or cool lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. This is the Winged Hussar's Cross, the highest honour; make its winged cross silhouette unmistakable.
